qt: to the Commission Fabio De Masi (NI) Subject:
Has the Polish Government honoured the European arrest warrant obligations by failing to execute the arrest warrant requested by the German Federal Prosecutor-General within the prescribed period?
at: (English version) to the Commission Fabio De Masi (NI) (4 December 2024) Subject: Arrest warrant for the Nord Stream gas pipelines Has the Polish Government honoured the European arrest warrant obligations by failing to execute the arrest warrant requested by the German Federal Prosecutor-General within the prescribed period? (14 February 2025) As already indicated in the reply to parliamentary Question E-001695/2024, which also related to the Nord Stream pipeline, the European arrest warrant is an entirely judicial procedure between the judicial authorities in the Member States based on the particular circumstances of each individual case where surrender is requested. Neither the Commission nor the Member States’ governments can interfere or influence decisions taken by judicial authorities.
